heading: Purpose
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "1", "part": "1.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "1", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The purpose of this Act is to make fresh provision for the law of evidence that is uniform with Commonwealth and New South Wales law.

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "1", "part": "1.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "3", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null, "subitem": null, "subclause": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "1", "part": "1.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "3", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null, "subitem": null, "subclause": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "1", "part": "1.1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "3", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null, "subitem": null, "subclause": null}

heading: Courts and proceedings to which Act applies
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "1", "part": "1.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "4", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "1", "part": "1.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "4", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This Act applies to all proceedings in a Victorian court, including proceedings that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "1", "part": "1.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "4", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: relate to bail; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "1", "part": "1.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "4", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: are interlocutory proceedings or proceedings of a similar kind; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "1", "part": "1.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "4", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: are heard in chambers; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "1", "part": "1.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "4", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: subject to subsection (2), relate to sentencing.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "1", "part": "1.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "4", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If such a proceeding relates to sentencing—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "1", "part": "1.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "4", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: this Act applies only if the court directs that the law of evidence applies in the proceeding; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "1", "part": "1.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "4", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the court specifies in the direction that the law of evidence applies only in relation to specified matters—the direction has effect accordingly.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "1", "part": "1.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "4", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The court must make a direction if—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "1", "part": "1.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "4", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a party to the proceeding applies for such a direction in relation to the proof of a fact; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "1", "part": "1.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "4", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: in the court's opinion, the proceeding involves proof of that fact, and that fact is or will be significant in determining a sentence to be imposed in the proceeding.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "1", "part": "1.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "4", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The court must make a direction if the court considers it appropriate to make such a direction in the interests of justice.
